caption: Coleman v. Home Depot, Inc.
citation_line: Coleman v. Home Depot, Inc., 306 F.3d 1333 (3d Cir. 2002)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Cooper excluded an EEOC letter finding reasonable cause to believe race and sex discrimination had occurred, and a jury returned a defense verdict.
qualification_rationale: The appeal resolved a circuit-divided evidence question: whether an EEOC determination that is admissible under the public-records exception is nevertheless subject to exclusion under Federal Rule of Evidence 403.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, holding that EEOC determination letters are not per se admissible and may be excluded case by case when Rule 403 considerations substantially outweigh probative value.
